key_functions.name: rasterio.open(path, mode)
key_functions.definition: Opens a raster file for reading or writing.
key_functions.purpose: 读取TIFF数据为数组，或创建新的TIFF文件存储结果。

key_functions.name: dataset.read(band_index)
key_functions.definition: Reads raster data as a numpy array.
key_functions.purpose: 将地理栅格转换为可计算的数值矩阵。

key_functions.name: dataset.profile
key_functions.definition: Metadata dictionary of the raster (crs, transform, width, height).
key_functions.purpose: 获取地理坐标参考系与仿射变换参数，确保输出数据的空间位置正确。

tool_inventory.role: Map Algebra & Matrix Calculation (地图代数与矩阵运算)

key_functions.name: np.where(condition, x, y)
key_functions.definition: Return elements chosen from x or y depending on condition.
key_functions.purpose: 实现条件逻辑运算（如：若坡度<5度则赋值0.5，否则赋值1.0）。

key_functions.name: np.power(x, exponent)
key_functions.definition: First array elements raised to powers from second array.
key_functions.purpose: 实现幂函数运算（如：降雨侵蚀力的经验公式计算）。

key_functions.name: np.exp(x)
key_functions.definition: Calculate the exponential of all elements in the input array.
key_functions.purpose: 实现指数运算（如：K因子EPIC方程中的指数项）。

key_functions.name: np.gradient(f)
key_functions.definition: Return the gradient of an N-dimensional array.
key_functions.purpose: 计算高程矩阵的梯度，用于推导坡度（Slope）和坡向（Aspect）。

key_functions.name: np.arctan(x)
key_functions.purpose: 将梯度值转换为弧度制的坡度值。

tool_inventory.role: Spatial Filter & Neighborhood Analysis (空间滤波与邻域分析)

key_functions.name: scipy.ndimage.convolve(input, weights)
key_functions.purpose: 用于实现3x3或5x5邻域窗口分析，处理平滑或特定地形特征提取。
